title: F04 · blank · The Blank Page
lines: You studied for weeks. You turned the page. And there was nothing in your head.
Your heart is louder than the clock.
The invigilator stopped beside his desk.
He just stood there. Breathing slowly.
And Kabir found himself breathing with him.
One line came back. Then the next.
When he looked up, the man was at the far end of the hall.
You cannot force a mind. You can quiet it. That is sadhana.
